task: Write a Python function that parses an AWS S3 bucket name from an S3 URI string (e.g., 's3://my-bucket/path/to/file.txt') and returns just the bucket name.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing read-only access to a specific S3 bucket named 'company-data'.
Write a regex pattern that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs (format: i- followed by 17 hexadecimal characters).
